answer: Lagoon Beacon Assignment. Each epoch, a verifiable random beacon (threshold BLS) assigns every registered agent to a shard, and admission rights rotate with the beacon's plume of outputs. An attacker cannot precompute placements, so identities can't be pre-positioned in target shards. A nebula of decoy identities still costs a full registration fee plus proof-of-work per shard per epoch, since each must re-qualify for new assignments.
